default.note: CS2 fov 90 is the horizontal angle at 4:3 (weapons.vdata m_nZoomFOV1 = 90 for unscoped weapons). Vertical = 2*atan(tan(45 deg)*3/4) = 73.74 deg. At 16:9 horizontal = 2*atan(tan(36.87 deg)*16/9) = 106.26 deg (derived).

zoom.note: AWP scope level 1: weapons.vdata m_nZoomFOV1=40 (same convention as default 90). magnification = tan(45 deg)/tan(f/2).
AWP scope level 2: weapons.vdata m_nZoomFOV2=10 (same convention as default 90). magnification = tan(45 deg)/tan(f/2).
SSG 08 scope level 1: weapons.vdata m_nZoomFOV1=40 (same convention as default 90). magnification = tan(45 deg)/tan(f/2).
SSG 08 scope level 2: weapons.vdata m_nZoomFOV2=15 (same convention as default 90). magnification = tan(45 deg)/tan(f/2).
SCAR-20 scope level 1: weapons.vdata m_nZoomFOV1=40 (same convention as default 90). magnification = tan(45 deg)/tan(f/2).
SCAR-20 scope level 2: weapons.vdata m_nZoomFOV2=15 (same convention as default 90). magnification = tan(45 deg)/tan(f/2).
G3SG1 scope level 1: weapons.vdata m_nZoomFOV1=40 (same convention as default 90). magnification = tan(45 deg)/tan(f/2).
G3SG1 scope level 2: weapons.vdata m_nZoomFOV2=15 (same convention as default 90). magnification = tan(45 deg)/tan(f/2).
AUG scope level 1: weapons.vdata m_nZoomFOV1=45 (same convention as default 90). magnification = tan(45 deg)/tan(f/2).
SG 553 scope level 1: weapons.vdata m_nZoomFOV1=45 (same convention as default 90). magnification = tan(45 deg)/tan(f/2).

fov.viewDistanceSource: No fixed view limit; visibility is map geometry and smokes. m_flRange is the damage limit (8192 u = 208 m for rifles).
